annotation_provenance.method: request-only AI-assisted entity candidates reviewed and approved by project owner
annotation_provenance.review_summary: Project owner reviewed all 66 assistant-reviewed proposal rows and requested no corrections. The reviewed rows preserve the proposal sheet exact spans and include 8 approved empty-entity rows.

limitations: Entity labels are AI-assisted and owner-approved, not independently adjudicated ground truth.
The sample is targeted for explicit entity cues and is not a prevalence-representative random sample.
Rare entity types may have zero or very small support; per-type results must show support.
No rule changes may be made using the held-out entity sample or its evaluation results.

metrics_publication.reason: Component-level entity scores are not published; project-level quantitative results focus on the paired end-to-end raw-LLM versus final-system comparison.

sample_selection: Targeted request-text sample selected to exercise explicit entity cues; one example per duplicate group. Not a prevalence-representative random sample.
